nodes.label: Use Connection Pooling for All Applications
nodes.rationale: Impact CRITICAL, handles 10-100x more concurrent users: Postgres connections cost 1-3MB each, so one connection per request exhausts the database at a few hundred users. A pooler such as PgBouncer lets 500 users share ~10 real connections, sized as (CPU cores * 2) + spindle count.

nodes.label: Transaction Mode vs Session Mode Pooling
nodes.rationale: Transaction mode returns the connection after each transaction and suits most apps; session mode holds it for the whole session and is required for prepared statements and temp tables.
